notes.title: Patch 1.2.7
notes.content:
Back with a quick hello so insignificant it's barely worth raising a hand to wave back. Here's what we did in this update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41892024/cb0af692e1378b76273c1b0037020cddd9287878.png

CH2: Minor design tweaks in the Mainland.
CH2: The Pit level now requires Rogue Gloves to enter it to save players who don't have them from wasting their time.
CH3: Removed "wind" ambience from the level "Speed Test".
CH3: The reason for this update. Fixed a bug in which if players visited the Grotto after choosing to go to Machina, the game would stick when talking to the NPC named Stubs. The game will no longer stick here.

ALSO: We are now officially verified for Steam Deck!

If you notice anything odd, don't be shy. Please feel free to join the game's official Discord and let it be known!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.6
notes.content:
Ho, ho, ho! Merry December 1st!

I'm here with the first update to the game. Nothing super major, but after watching complete strangers play the game online, I decided to add a few fixes I noticed to improve the overall experience of the game.

If you notice anything odd, don't be shy. Please feel free to join the game's official Discord and let it be known! In the meantime, enjoy the following improvements:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41892024/cb0af692e1378b76273c1b0037020cddd9287878.png

-Prologue: Edited the movie sequence scene so that if players stand still, Billy is pushed forward with the moving auto-scroll.
-Prologue: Edited the camcorder art asset in the movie sequence so that it does not appear over top of menus if players press start during it.
-Prologue: Added an executive producer credit in opening credits.
-CH1: Fixed minor issue that allowed players to purchase the sold out app called "Questier Quest" that is meant to simply be a joke.
-CH1: Edited the "cave-in" sequence so that if players stand still, Billy is pushed forward with the moving auto-scroll.
-CH1: Fixed error in which players can skip the Health Booster tutorial in North Arlet.
-CH1: Edited "Lair" -- these are the series of Caves that lead to finding Professor Lee. Slight level design modifications.
-CH1: Fixed two invisible ledges in pits (Arlet West, Lair 2-2, Fireball Alley)
-CH2: Fixed major bug in "Deep" that could have led to a side-quest being skipped entirely.
-CH2: Added more chests and reduced difficulty through design in Mainland.
